watch.summary: A streamer tells chat he can handle straight constructive criticism about his Rocket League skills, only to get hit with a blunt 'You suck, dude.'

beats.what: A chat TTS voice says his rotations are a bit awkward.
The streamer says to just tell him directly because he can take constructive criticism.
The TTS voice bluntly blurts out 'You suck, dude.'

watch.author: mixed
watch.why: The comedic beat hits perfectly when the streamer asks for unfiltered honesty and immediately gets shut down with a three-word roast. The concise timing of the TTS voice delivers a clean, punchy payoff.
